messages:
Liam G.: Quick note 11 mid-cycle rapid calibration this week. Were compressing reviews into a 48h window to accommodate launch timelines. Manager edits due Thu 2025-09-18 16:00 UTC.

Hannah P.: New process: use the "Rapid Manager Form" (same fields but smaller free-text). Link: https://go/redwood/rapid-form.

Ravi S.: How do we flag hires with <30 days?

Liam G.: Add HEADER flag TENURE_SHORT and 1-line recommendation. Those go to an "exceptions" pile and only get light calibration.

Jules T.: Any change for LOA?

Liam G.: LOA still in payroll_exceptions. If leave overlaps review window, mark LOA_TYPE and dates; People Ops will exclude by default.

Hannah P.: Calibration blocks: Fri 2025-09-19 10:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (45m). Signup: https://go/redwood/rapid-cal. Pick one.

Ravi S.: New managers: can we book a 20m run-through?

Liam G.: Yes 0m slots Thu 2025-09-18 09:00 and 15:00 UTC. Sign up via the same cal link.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Thu 2025-09-18 16:00 UTC" posted 2025-09-16 08:00 UTC. Reaction: :bell:

Jules T.: Export tip for eng managers: use Admin -> Exports -> RapidReviewCSV. If you get a mapping error ping Ravi with screenshot.

Liam G.: Final: well lock signups 2h before each panel. If you absolutely need a late change, file an exception with EXCEPTION_REASON=urgent_change and DM people-ops.
